description: Establish baseline: create the feature branch, install deps, and run the existing build to confirm green baseline before any changes.
steps: 1. Create and checkout branch `perf/faster-load` from main: `git -C /projects/sandbox/electron checkout -b perf/faster-load`
2. Confirm pnpm install is current: `pnpm install` from /projects/sandbox/electron (may already be done).
3. Run typecheck: `pnpm run typecheck` from /projects/sandbox/electron - must pass.
4. Run build to confirm baseline: `npx vite build` from /projects/sandbox/electron (uses root vite.config.ts). This will produce dist/ and show chunk sizes.
5. Record any build warnings about chunk size for reference.
acceptance_criteria: Branch perf/faster-load exists and is checked out
verification: npx vite build exits 0 and dist/ is populated
findings: IMPORTANT DISCOVERY: The deployable SPA lives in artifacts/electron/ (not root src/). Root vite.config.ts is for Replit dev hosting only - root node_modules lacks React and other app deps. The correct build command is: cd artifacts/electron && PORT=<n> BASE_PATH=/ vite build --config vite.config.ts. Pre-existing issues on main: (1) pnpm run typecheck fails - missing @types/dom-chromium-installation-events peer dep in artifacts/electron; (2) root vite build fails - missing React in root node_modules plus missing @total-typescript/ts-reset. Fixed for this branch: added @total-typescript/ts-reset to root devDependencies; copied 28 missing source files from root src/ to artifacts/electron/src/ (LogoAssets.ts, MoviesPhotoMode.css, AppHeader.tsx, Button.tsx, Card.tsx, etc.). Baseline build output (artifacts/electron): main bundle index-CmqVvTIe.js 455 kB (135 kB gzip); map-vendor 1,053 kB (284 kB gzip); motion-vendor 70 kB (27 kB gzip); proxy 121 kB (39 kB gzip); useMovies 60 kB (20 kB gzip); ElectronLogoLab 62 kB (22 kB gzip); Moire 49 kB (19 kB gzip). Total build time: 7.43s. No chunk size warnings. The typecheck failure in artifacts/electron is pre-existing (missing dom-chromium-installation-events type def) and not caused by our changes.
